name: Checkbox
description: A widget that allows users to toggle between checked and unchecked states (dual-state), or checked, unchecked, and partially checked states (tri-state).

keyboard_interactions.action: Toggles the checkbox state between checked, unchecked, and (if tri-state) partially checked

roles.description: Identifies the element as a checkbox

required_attributes.description: State. 'mixed' is the tri-state (indeterminate) value — the one thing a native checkbox cannot express through an attribute, and the only real reason to use role='checkbox'.
Provided via visible text content, aria-labelledby, or aria-label

optional_attributes.description: References the visible label for the group

notes: Use <input type='checkbox'>. It is focusable, toggles on Space, announces correctly, and posts a form value. role='checkbox' on a div reimplements all of that, worse.

Tri-state: a native checkbox's indeterminate state is a JS PROPERTY (el.indeterminate = true), not an attribute. It maps to aria-checked='mixed' automatically — you do not set aria-checked yourself on a native input.
indeterminate is purely visual+a11y: the checkbox still submits as checked or unchecked. Track the real tri-state in your own model.
Group related checkboxes in <fieldset><legend> (RAWeb 11.5). Without it, 'Email' is announced with no hint that the question was 'How should we contact you?'.
Do not use aria-checked on a native <input type='checkbox'> — the browser derives it from .checked. Setting both can conflict.
A checkbox that applies immediately is probably a switch — see patterns/switch.md.
native_element: <input type="checkbox"> — use it; the ARIA version exists only for tri-state

raweb_criteria.reason: A checkbox is a form field: it needs a real associated label.
The label must describe what checking it means, not just repeat the field name.
Related checkboxes must be grouped in a fieldset with a legend, or the group's question is never announced.
Only for role='checkbox': the checked state must be exposed via aria-checked, including 'mixed'.
The focus indicator must be visible, including on a custom-styled checkbox.
